links.outcome: Agreement of AI triage classifications with two independent clinicians (weighted Cohen's kappa)
links.effect: Substantial agreement with independent clinicians (weighted kappa 0.66-0.72), strengthening in longer conversations; 61 in-scope triage sessions from 28 participants.
links.quote: AI triage classifications demonstrated substantial agreement with independent clinicians  (κ = 0.66–0.72) , strengthening in longer conversations.
